summary: Master BIM for Real Estate to optimize asset performance and ROI. Learn ISO 19650, COBie, and Digital Twin integration in this 10-day professional course.
lede: Building Information Modeling (BIM) for real estate helps professionals manage structured digital information across a property’s lifecycle, from inception through operation and disposal. This course focuses on the ISO 19650 framework and Industry Foundation Classes (IFC), connecting construction-phase deliverables with long-term asset value. Learn to evaluate BIM Execution Plans, check COBie data drops, manage Level of Development requirements, and integrate Asset Information Models with Integrated Workplace Management Systems. You will also explore Digital Twins, IoT integration, Common Data Environment platforms, and Navisworks while developing practical approaches to data integrity, measurable digital delivery, cost control, decarbonization, and tenant satisfaction.
audienceIntro: This course is essential for professionals responsible for the financial performance, operational efficiency, and strategic growth of property portfolios.
audience: Sustainability Consultants using BIM for ESG
Digital Transformation Leads in the property
modules: BIM for Asset and Facility Management
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of real estate development or asset management processes. Familiarity with project management principles is recommended. No prior experience with 3D modeling software is required, though an awareness of the construction lifecycle is beneficial.
